releases.title: Recent updates
changes: The Open tasks sheet's leading button now says "Cancel".
The timer widget's cancel control is labelled "Cancel session" for VoiceOver, and the Shortcuts action is "Cancel session".

releases.title: Recent updates
changes: Life no longer offers the retired Crown position setting.
Life areas and tasks have clearer empty states.
Life text and weekly time controls follow your text size setting.
Completing a task is the only action that gives a haptic in Life.

releases.title: Recent updates
changes: The Focus timer widget fits its size. Each size shows Pause or Resume, Forward and Cancel as icons, and large also shows Stop.
A repeating Plan Ahead schedule shows its days on the month calendar before you open each week.

releases.title: Recent updates
changes: Back up Spread saves a backup file and a plan file you can read and edit.
Add a backup or a plan file back as a new profile. Your current profiles are not changed.
A plan file can be merged into the open profile after you preview the changes. Nothing changes until you tap Merge.
Removing areas or tasks is off by default, and you turn it on in the preview.

releases.title: Recent updates
changes: The timer widget shows how many of today's planned blocks you have finished.
The progress line shows counts only. Nothing starts on its own, and Life area names appear only if you turn them on.

releases.title: Recent updates
changes: Start today's planned time from the Timer widget, the Dynamic Island or the focus timer. Focus rounds are sized to the hours you planned.
Each round and each break starts only when you tap. Nothing starts on its own.
A finished block is remembered for the day, so it is not offered again. The next planned block comes up.
A planned block on the Dynamic Island opens Today.

releases.title: Recent updates
changes: Plan Ahead now suggests plans based on this week. Tap one to review it, then confirm it or change it first.
A new Make a new plan button sits at the top of Plan Ahead.
A repeating plan now shows its hours and days on the week it starts, even if you looked at that week before the plan existed.
The Next 8 weeks list is gone from Plan Ahead, so it only shows plans you have made.

releases.title: Recent updates
changes: Move between Life and Week with smoother transitions, including Undo and Redo.
Use the new Focus Timer to start, pause, and resume sessions, with optional reminders.
See today's task progress and planned hours from optional Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets.
Follow an active Focus Timer on the Lock Screen or Dynamic Island, and tap to return to Spread.

releases.title: Recent updates
changes: Plan Ahead can now save fixed days, such as the gym on set days, with hours for each day.

releases.title: A clearer way to plan your week
changes: Set weekly hours right from Life. Tap an area in the time strip to adjust its hours.
Plan Ahead lets you move hours into future weeks after reviewing the change.
The Week screen has a smaller task inbox and a clearer way to browse weeks.
Mark important tasks with a red exclamation point.
Create areas with Add Life and find fewer duplicate controls in More.
